design_philosophy.identity: Editorial organic-food aesthetic combining Telangana earth tones with clean modern ecommerce structure.
core_principles: Heritage meets Modernity: Use refined serif for storytelling, clean readable sans-serif for commerce.
Authenticity over Artificiality: Real farm photography, deep textures, no generic shiny stock images.
Restrained Geometry: Softly rounded product cards, airy padding, deliberate negative space.
Cinematic Storytelling: Kinetic scrolling, cross-fading videos, and bold editorial layouts to create emotional connection.

rules: Use Instrument Serif for all main headings and editorial callouts. NEVER make Instrument Serif bold; use font-normal or italic for elegance.
Use Hanken Grotesk for prices, buttons, filters, navigation, and dense body copy.
For typography on top of images/video, use text-white/90 with a subtle drop-shadow-sm for contrast if necessary, or rely on dark gradient overlays (max 40% opacity).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical e-commerce designs. Let the photography and typography breathe.

interactive_motion.scrolling: Implement @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. Tune lerp to 0.08 for a 'heavy, luxurious' feel.
interactive_motion.hero_video: 3-video cinematic auto-crossfading sequence (hands in grain -> crop fields -> sunlight in forest). Absolute positioning with framer-motion opacity crossfades (duration 1.5s).
interactive_motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (y: 20 -> 0) on scroll using framer-motion 'whileInView'.
interactive_motion.hover_states: Images scale up 5% (duration-700 ease-out). Buttons translate y -2px and increase shadow.

hero_videos.description: Hands full of grain in a sack (cinematic close-up)

media_assets.rules: Avoid generic green-field stock imagery. Use only the provided hyper-tactile, close-up texture images of grains, hands, and earth.

accessibility: Ensure all text over images or videos has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 using subtle gradients if necessary.
Maintain semantic HTML tags (header, main, section, footer).
Provide ARIA labels for icon-only buttons (like Cart, Search, Menu).
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, links, cart inputs) to facilitate E2E testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install `@studio-freight/react-lenis` and wrap the root Layout in a `<Lenis>` provider to enable smooth kinetic scrolling.
Build the 3-video cinematic hero component with an auto-playing sequence. Map through the provided video URLs, crossfading opacity with framer-motion.
Import 'Instrument Serif' and 'Hanken Grotesk' via Google Fonts into the global CSS or index.html.
Implement the headless Shopify connection or mock product data perfectly using the 'deep soil brown', 'millet gold' palette.
Build the Editorial Marquee with CSS or framer-motion, using a slow, organic drift.
The UI should not feel like a standard generic SaaS. Overlap images in the Manifesto section, use massive serif typography for quotes, and ensure product cards have refined padding.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply global 'transition: all' styles. Be specific (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do not center-align body text or massive blocks of content. Maintain left-alignment for readability, only centering specific hero headers or short artistic quotes.
Use 2-3x more padding/margin between sections (py-24 or py-32) than default. Cramped layouts ruin the premium feel.
Use exact hex colors defined in the palette. Do NOT use default tailwind blues or grays.
Never use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided asset URLs.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive components.
